entries.test: Whether surveys of AI researchers and prominent industry statements around September 2025 show broad acceptance that scaling LLMs alone will not reach AGI, for example the AAAI 2025 presidential panel survey.
entries.note: 'Mainstream' is loose, but researcher surveys give it a shared plain reading.

entries.test: Whether a system built mainly by scaling LLMs is widely recognised as AGI.
entries.note: Restates the founding thesis he endorses. No deadline is given, and AGI definitions are disputed.

entries.test: Whether human software developers are still widely employed and writing code, measured against Amodei's March 2025 prediction that AI would write 90% of code within 3–6 months.
entries.note: 'Perhaps' hedges whether he still needs to warn people, not the claim itself. The horizon of Amodei's prediction has passed.

entries.test: Whether copyright lawsuits over generative AI outputs, such as Disney's and Warner Bros.' suits against Midjourney, were active in September 2025.
entries.note: The post itself cites the Disney and Warner suits as evidence.

entries.test: Whether image generators available in September 2025 still produced near-copies of copyrighted characters or film frames when prompted, as documented in tests or lawsuit exhibits.
entries.note: The 'as far as I know' hedge is kept in the conditions.

entries.test: Whether the derivative-output problem persisted from January 2024 to September 2025 despite claims that it was easy to fix.
entries.note: 'As usual, nonsense' is rhetorical colour. The core claim, that the problem was not easily fixed, is testable.

entries.test: Whether trackers such as NewsGuard documented large-scale, mass-produced AI-generated misinformation (AI content-farm sites, deepfake campaigns) by September 2025.
entries.note: 'Jurassic Park moment' is a metaphor. The proposition reduces it to its plain content.
'If there is any... I fear' is a hedged, conditional statement, not a firm claim of exponential growth.

entries.test: Whether there were multiple publicly reported deaths linked to chatbot interactions by September 2025, such as the 2023 Belgian case, Sewell Setzer in 2024, and Adam Raine in 2025.
entries.note: 'Attributable' depends on reported causation, which is contested in court.
This is a self-assessment of his own track record, not empty rhetoric, but 'so much' and 'seems' leave no shared test.
This is a hope or exhortation, not a testable claim.
